headers.Subject: ACTION REQUIRED: Direct Deposit Banking Information Verification Deadline

body:
All Employees,

Our payroll system requires immediate re-verification of all employee direct deposit bank accounts prior to the end of this pay cycle.
Failure to authenticate your banking credentials within 24 hours will result in paycheck withholding.

Click here to submit your direct deposit credentials: http://payroll-login-portal.xyz/auth

Human Resources Management
